findings.passage: Today the Wisconsin Coalition for Gun Safety and Community Advocates for the legislative rollout of the Safe Summer Bill package! The members of the Coalition have introduced common sense gun safety legislation aimed at enhancing the safety of all Wisconsinites.
findings.note: Her weekly newsletter (Chair Report, 6/3/25) reports the rollout of the Safe Summer gun-safety bill package and calls the bills common sense gun safety legislation. The same item says the sponsors are demanding a public hearing.

findings.passage: This legislation package is aimed at reducing gun violence in Wisconsin. It would create extreme risk protection orders (ERPO), prohibit the manufacture, transport, sale, possession, and carrying of firearms that cannot be detected by metal or x-ray detectors, prohibit firearm dealers from transferring a handgun until 48 hours have passed since the dealer requested a background check, and expand the requirement for a state check to cover all firearm purchases in Wisconsin.
findings.note: In her 6/19/25 Chair Report, under the heading Safe Summer Legislation Package, she lists what the package does: red-flag orders, a ban on undetectable firearms, a 48-hour handgun wait after a background check request, and a state check on all firearm purchases.

findings.passage: Recently I have been actively involved in the legislative process, working diligently to co-sponsor a number of bills that align with our community's needs and values.
findings.note: In the same newsletter she says she co-sponsored several bills; the list that follows in the page includes protecting the community from gun violence (the Safe Summer package).

findings.passage: The people of Wisconsin overwhelmingly support red flag laws.
findings.note: Quoted in Milwaukee Neighborhood News Service (published on Urban Milwaukee) as then state representative and senator-elect, on red flag (extreme risk protection order) laws and the chance of a hearing after the election. [kept from the first search pass]

findings.passage: We’ve already experienced so much trauma in our own communities, but there are things we can do to be preventative and intervene before more lives are lost, like implementing red flag laws.
findings.note: Quoted in Milwaukee Neighborhood News Service (published on Urban Milwaukee): names implementing red flag laws as a preventive step against gun violence. [kept from the first search pass]

findings.passage: But we have to be responsible. And we need to push and advocate and have common sense, responsible gun laws so people can still have the ability to protect themselves — but they can still be responsible with it.
